basic_info.description: Ideally situated near Golden Gate Park and Ocean Beach, this stunning Sunset home boasts elegance from floor to ceiling. Step into the foyer and be greeted by exquisite wood detailing and rich hardwood floors that flow seamlessly throughout. The living room features classic bay windows that flood the space with natural light, a charming original fireplace, and high ceilings for an airy feel. Adjacent to the living room, the formal dining room is perfect for intimate dinners and lively gatherings. The main upper level includes a well-appointed kitchen, a spacious primary suite with an en-suite bath, two more generously sized bedrooms, and a convenient powder room for guests. On the lower level, two finished rooms offer versatile spaceideal for a home office, gym, studio, or hobby room. Additional highlights include an attached garage and a private backyard, both rare gems in the city. Moments from the best of Irving and Judah Streets, enjoy notable eateries like Arizmendi Bakery, Dumpling Kitchen, Hook Fish Co., and Andytown Coffee Roasters, as well as cultural hotspots including the de Young Museum and Japanese Tea Garden. With easy MUNI access and Ocean Beach minutes away, 1462 29th Ave is the perfect blend of convenience, charm, and coastal living.
